from itertools import combinations
import networkx as nx

def is_triangle_free(G):
    """Check if graph G has no triangles."""
    for u, v, w in combinations(G.nodes(), 3):
        if G.has_edge(u, v) and G.has_edge(v, w) and G.has_edge(u, w):
            return False
    return True

def is_maximal_triangle_free(G, n):
    """Check if G is maximal triangle-free: adding any missing edge creates a triangle."""
    nodes = list(range(n))
    for u, v in combinations(nodes, 2):
        if not G.has_edge(u, v):
            # Check if adding (u,v) would create a triangle
            # i.e., u and v have a common neighbor
            neighbors_u = set(G.neighbors(u))
            neighbors_v = set(G.neighbors(v))
            if not (neighbors_u & neighbors_v):
                return False  # Can add this edge without triangle
    return True

part1 = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]

for u in part1:
